name: PostHog
summary: Product analytics platform (events, session replay, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, surveys, data warehouse) with a hosted MCP server and a REST API through which an agent can create, launch and read A/B experiments. The MCP tools reference listed 966 tools in 72 categories on 2026-09-16, and the vendor ships a single-tool CLI mode, a read-only switch and category filters for that reason. Every surface needs a PostHog account first; the free tier needs no card.

payments.notes: 2026-09-25: no page read answered or mentioned a 402; MCP calls are free and usage bills to a card the pricing page names ('Add a card', 'card on file'). Invoices need 'an upfront credit purchase' through sales. Experiments bill per feature-flag request, first 1M a month free.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-16: hosted MCP initialize with no token answers 401, header naming the protected-resource metadata, which names oauth.posthog.com. That server advertises a registration endpoint, public clients (auth method none), S256 PKCE and an agent_auth skill at oauth.posthog.com/auth.md.

jobs.summary: Experiments: variants served through feature flags, users randomized, exposures tracked, and the result computed by a stated Bayesian or frequentist method; an agent can create, launch, read and end an experiment over MCP or the API.
